    Bitcoin vs Solana (BTC vs SOL)

    As of November 22, 2026 (Binance daily close): Bitcoin closed at $61,271.08 and Solana at $70.730, so 1 BTC = 866.3 SOL.

    ⚡ Live BTC price ⚡ Live SOL price 🔁 Convert BTC to SOL

    BTC vs SOL: what the numbers show

    Bitcoin's market cap of about $1.25T is 30 times Solana's ($41.13B); they rank #1 and #7 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Bitcoin fell 27.7% and Solana fell 44.6%, a gap of 16.9 percentage points in Bitcoin's favour. Solana was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (63.5% annualized against 46.8%). Within the year, Bitcoin's largest fall between daily closes was 39.5% and Solana's was 57.6%. On November 22, 2026 Bitcoin was 36.8% below its 52-week high and Solana 51.8% below its own. In 8 of the last 12 complete months, Bitcoin did better than Solana. Over the last 90 days the daily moves of Solana and Bitcoin had a correlation of 0.85 (very closely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep).
